text:
Cinematic 16:9 sci-fi concept art, viewed from a desert dune at twilight. Wind-rippled copper-orange sand fills the foreground, with deep violet-brown hollows and fine sand drifting off the crests. On the left foreground ridge, one short-haired traveler seen from behind wears a long dark burgundy cloak and boots; immediately to their left stands one shaggy brown llama, ears upright. Both face the distant city and cast long shadows toward the lower left.

Center-right on the horizon, a futuristic metropolis rises from layered, saucer-like terraces edged in cyan, surrounded by smaller buildings with amber windows. Three tapering glass spires dominate: the tallest in the middle, encircled near its tip by a brilliant horizontal cyan halo; a shorter teal spire on the left bearing a vertical cyan sign reading “OASIS” top to bottom; and a shorter purple spire on the right edged in magenta. Thin turquoise searchlight beams fan into the sky.

An elevated, gold-lit monorail on slender dark pylons enters from the bottom right, bends left, then sweeps back toward the city. One sleek blue-silver train with dark windows rounds the near bend. Behind the track at lower right lies a glowing turquoise oasis pool. A huge ribbed dark-green saguaro with three raised arms and a hot-pink neon outline stands in front of the water; one tiny cactus stands on the far bank.

Sparse stars, a huge crescent moon lit along its lower-right rim in the upper left, and a navy-to-mauve sky fading to amber at the right horizon. Atmospheric, finely detailed digital matte painting.
